purpose: Apply the preregistered dual-prior reliability gate, then expose every set disagreement to a role-blinded semantic adjudication before any training gold is materialized.

agreement_metrics.eligibility_agreement: Exact eligibility equality divided by all 64 rows.
agreement_metrics.usable_overlap: Rows for which both annotators selected eligibility=usable.
agreement_metrics.row_unit_set_f1: For a usable-overlap row and one target, 2*|A intersection B|/(|A|+|B|).
agreement_metrics.macro_unit_f1: Unweighted mean of row_unit_set_f1 over usable-overlap rows; candidate rows are not pooled by unit count.
agreement_metrics.row_unit_jaccard: |A intersection B|/|A union B|, reported as a diagnostic only.
agreement_metrics.exact_set_agreement: The two unit-index arrays are identical.
agreement_metrics.nested_fraction: Fraction of usable annotations, across both annotators, satisfying key subset-of complete.

disagreement_definition.requires_adjudication: Any row with different eligibility, key_unit_indices, or complete_unit_indices.
disagreement_definition.automatic_adoption: Only rows with identical eligibility and identical key/complete sets may be adopted without semantic adjudication; rationale or confidence differences alone do not change the target.
disagreement_definition.failed_agreement_gate: Do not use adjudication to rescue a failed annotator-agreement gate. Repair guide or unitization under a new version first.

adjudication_blinding.candidate_order: For each item, SHA256('clir-dual-prior-adjudication-v1:' + item_id) parity deterministically decides whether primary is A or B; the mapping is stored only in private lineage.
adjudication_blinding.semantic_rule: Re-evaluate the problem and trajectory under annotation_guide_v1. Adopt A, adopt B, or synthesize a new whole-unit nested target; do not majority-vote or average binary targets.

adjudication_output_contract.durability: One validated adjudication row must be checkpointed immediately before judging the next disagreement.
